messages:
Maya Patel: @Priya @Sam need a quick deal-desk sanity check — AcmeMed wants a bespoke discount for a Dedicated POC -> prod commit. Details: list = $120,000/yr (reserved GPUs), term = 12 months, ask = 35% off. Procurement deadline Friday. Can we approve or escalate?

Sam Ortiz: 35% is above our normal cap for 12mo. Can you drop the business rationale and the expected expansion so we can run numbers? Also paste the pricing calc link.

Maya Patel: Sure — short bullets: 1) Customer: AcmeMed (enterprise healthcare analytics) 2) Use case: patient summarization + embeddings for search, sensitive data — they'd prefer Dedicated/private later 3) POC -> prod path: 3-month POC then full roll at month 4 4) Upside: if POC converts, they commit to 3 regions and ~3x spend in 12–18 months 5) Sales motion: exec sponsor (CTO) engaged, procurement needs SOW by Fri or they'll push to other vendors. Pricing calc: `https://redwood.sheets/pricing/acmemed-1934567890` 6) Ask: 35% -> net $78k/yr.

Priya Nair: Thanks. Need finance sign-off for >30%. Also ask: can we trade term/commit for the headroom? If they move to 18mo or 24mo, we can do more.

Raj Chen: Quick finance check — what's incremental margin at 35%? If base cost (infra+support) is ~ $40k/yr, margin goes to 38% at $78k. That's tight but acceptable if we get committed expansion language. Need clause in SOW: expansion milestone at month 6 or auto-escalation.

Maya Patel: We can push for 18mo and expansion milestone, but procurement is hard deadline on Friday. Asking if we can do a conditional approval (approve net price if they sign an 18mo or commit to expansion milestone).

Priya Nair: Conditional approvals are fine — deal-desk prefers clear gating. For >30% we require: (a) CRO sign-off, (b) Finance ack (Raj here), and (c) SOW with expansion milestone + clawback if expansion doesn't hit.

Kelly Tran (CRO): Saw this — AcmeMed looks strategic. I'm willing to sign off up to 32% if Maya can get exec sponsor to sign a 18mo commit or a 1.5x expansion trigger at month 6. Also need list of references and legal redlines flagged early.

Maya Patel: Can do. I'll push for 18mo with an expansion trigger. Ask to approve 32% then and I'll try to close procurement.

Raj Chen: Finance approves 32% conditional on those contract terms (18mo or expansion trigger + clawback). Margin at 32% is workable with the contingency.

Priya Nair: Deal-desk: APPROVED at 32% with CRO+Finance OK and SOW conditions documented. Please attach the final pricing calc and SOW to #deal-desk-approvals once signed. :white_check_mark:

deal-desk-bot: approval-recorded — ticket #DD-2026-4821, approval: 32%, approvers: Kelly Tran (CRO), Raj Chen (Finance), notes: conditional on 18mo term or expansion trigger and clawback.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — I'll update the SOW template and loop in legal. Pushing to procurement now, will post final signed SOW when done. :rocket:
